expectations.text: 交付物正文为中文（EN→ZH 方向），英文仅出现在术语对照表源语列或引用原文处，标题/说明/待确认清单均为中文
expectations.evidence: Entire deliverable (headings, parameter table, terminology mapping, Section 3 technical review) is in Chinese; English appears only in the source column of Section 2 and standard symbols.

expectations.text: Moulded-Case Circuit-Breaker 译为「塑壳断路器」，未直译为「模制外壳断路器」或「塑料外壳断路器」
expectations.evidence: Heading L11: "**NXM-250S 塑壳断路器（IEC 60947-2:2024）**"; Table L41: "Moulded-Case Circuit-Breaker | MCCB | 塑壳断路器".

expectations.text: Rated impulse withstand voltage 译为「额定冲击耐受电压」（用「冲击」不用「脉冲」）
expectations.evidence: Table L16: "额定冲击耐受电压 | Uimp | 8 kV"; L43 explicitly rules out "耐碰撞电压".

expectations.text: Rated service short-circuit breaking capacity 中的 service 译为「运行」（额定运行短路分断能力），不译「服务」
expectations.evidence: Table L22: "额定运行短路分断能力 | Ics | 36 kA rms（415 V AC 下，100% Icu）"; L49 aligns to IEC 60947-2:2024 Cl. 5.3.6.2.4.

expectations.text: Selectivity category 译为「选择性类别」（不误译为「使用类别」或「区分/歧视类别」），且准确译出 Icu1（相间对中性线交流电压下极极限短路分断能力 / 单极极限短路分断能力）并保留 Icu1 符号
expectations.evidence: Table L24: "选择性类别 | — | A 类" (L51 warns against conflating with 使用类别); Table L21: "额定相间对中性线交流电压下极极限短路分断能力 | Icu1 | 18 kA rms" (L48 cites Cl. 5.3.6.2.3 & 9.3.11).

expectations.text: 单位符号保留原文 kA rms / kA peak / V AC，未改写成「有效值」「峰值」「交流」
expectations.evidence: Table L15, L17, L20-23 retain "800 V AC", "415 V AC", "36 kA rms", "18 kA rms", "72 kA peak" verbatim without rewriting into 「有效值」「峰值」「交流」.

expectations.text: 所有数值照抄未换算（800 V、8 kV、250 A、36 kA rms、18 kA rms、72 kA peak、20,000、8,000）
expectations.evidence: Table L15-29 preserve all numeric values verbatim (800 V AC, 8 kV, 415 V AC, 250 A, 36 kA rms, 18 kA rms, 72 kA peak, 20,000, 8,000) without conversion or silent edits.

expectations.text: 指出源文内部矛盾：选择性类别 A 与给出 Isd（2～10 × Ir）短延时整定不能同时成立，且未擅自删除或改写参数
expectations.evidence: Preserves both A 类 (L24) and Isd 2 至 10 × Ir (L28), and flags the contradiction as Issue 1 (L66-75: "【阻断项】选择性类别（A 类）与短延时整定电流（Isd）自相矛盾").

expectations.text: 未补造源文缺失的 Icw 数值，并在待确认清单中明确指出 Icw 缺失
expectations.evidence: No fabricated Icw value in parameter table; L66, L68 & L74 explicitly flag Icw (and tsd) as missing for technical department confirmation.

expectations.text: 中文正文使用全角标点，参数符号/数值/单位内保持半角且数值与单位之间有单个半角空格
expectations.evidence: Chinese prose uses full-width punctuation (，。：（）【】); all parameter symbols, values, and units remain half-width with single half-width spaces (800 V AC, 8 kV, 250 A, 36 kA rms, 18 kA rms, 72 kA peak).
